description: Search DOJ equitable-sharing payments to state, local and tribal agencies by federal fiscal year. Defaults to the latest published DOJ year. Filters by two-letter state, DOJ-printed recipient-name substring and minimum row amount. Returns DOJ cash, sale proceeds, total, original recipient name, match method and matched ORI when one exists. A DOJ-masked recipient stays masked; an unmatched row is still a payment. With no state filter, returns all state subtotals and a separate foreign-sharing table. Foreign sharing is never added to payments to domestic agencies. Agency ESAC certifications use each agency's own fiscal year and include Treasury sharing; never add or subtract them from these DOJ payments. A seizure is not a crime or conviction; a payment follows participation in a forfeiture, not a finding of unlawful conduct.

fy.description: DOJ federal fiscal year; defaults to the latest published year.

min_amount.description: Optional minimum DOJ payment amount in dollars.

recipient.description: Optional case-insensitive recipient name substring. Masked agency names remain masked.

state.description: Optional two-letter state or territory code in the register index.

name: forfeiture_payments
title: Find DOJ Forfeiture Payments
